title: ETA Reliability: historical replay
notLive: A fixed historical replay of recorded BART data. It is not live.
disclosure: This curated replay shows only trains eligible for the model’s 5-, 10- and 15-minute forecast windows.
modelScope: The model predicts revisions to BART’s published ETA, not physical arrival times.

terms.bartPublishedEta: What BART said at the replay snapshot.
terms.modelAdjustedEta: BART’s published ETA plus the model’s predicted revision.
terms.finalPublishedEta: The final stable ETA BART published later: a retrospective outcome, not a physical arrival time.
terms.predictedRevision: Model-adjusted ETA minus BART published ETA.
terms.realizedRevision: Final published ETA minus BART published ETA.
terms.modelError: Model-adjusted ETA minus final published ETA.

selection.rule: Ranked by supported forecasts, then stations with supported forecasts, then trip runs, then the median absolute predicted revision (all descending), then the earliest time. Accuracy and outcomes are not read.
